# Preparation

## Packages and appearance

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
  library(pacman)
}
p_load(here, rio, tinytable, tidyverse)

options(rio.import.trust = TRUE)

```

## Load total data set

```{r}
#| label: getdata
#| message: false

pb_total <- import(here("data", "raw", "ZA2391_v17-0-0.dta"))

```

## Recode variables
```{r}
#| label: recoding

pb <- pb_total |> 
  mutate(
    class_ego = case_when(
      v65 %in% c(17, 19)  ~ "unskilled worker",
      v65 %in% c(18, 20)  ~ "skilled worker",
      v65 == 5            ~ "lower-grade employee",
      v65 %in% c(6:8)     ~ "higher-grade employee",
      v65 %in% c(9:13)    ~ "civil servant",
      v65 %in% c(1:4)     ~ "self-employed"
    ),
    class_hhv = case_when(
      v70 %in% c(17, 19)  ~ "unskilled worker",
      v70 %in% c(18, 20)  ~ "skilled worker",
      v70 == 5            ~ "lower-grade employee",
      v70 %in% c(6:8)     ~ "higher-grade employee",
      v70 %in% c(9:13)    ~ "civil servant",
      v70 %in% c(1:4)     ~ "self-employed"),
    class = ifelse(is.na(class_ego), class_hhv, class_ego),
    worker = case_when(
    class %in% c("unskilled worker", "skilled worker") ~ 1,
    class %in% c("lower-grade employee", "higher-grade employee",
                 "civil servant", "self-employed") ~ 0),
    pvote = ifelse(v6 < 0, NA, v6),
    pvote = case_when(
      v6 == 1   ~ "CDU/CSU",
      v6 == 4   ~ "SPD",
      v6 == 5   ~ "FDP",
      v6 == 6   ~ "Grüne",
      v6 == 7   ~ "Linke",
      v6 == 322 ~ "AfD",
      v6 == 392 ~ "BSW"),
    afd = ifelse(pvote == "AfD", 1, 0),
    spd = ifelse(pvote == "SPD", 1, 0),
    year = intyear,
    weight = if_else(year < 2000, pwght, dwght))

saveRDS(pb, here("data", "processed", "pb7724.rds"))

```
